premises.statement: Original input coordinates are independent and each has density bounded by one.
Conditioning outside selected original coordinates preserves the product law of the selected coordinates; outside cross couplings become affine terms.
premises.scope: elementary product-law conditioning used in the supporting theorem

premises.statement: A nonsingular cross minor alone is insufficient; a third smoothing direction is essential.

new_results.name: SEMI_CROSS_BINARY_L3
new_results.statement: For independent density<=1 X,Y, ||p_{alpha X^2+2aXY+rX+sY+c}||_3 <= 3|a|^{-2/3} for a!=0.

new_results.name: SEMI_CROSS_THREE_DIRECTION_BOUND
new_results.statement: If an original-coordinate principal block is [[alpha,a,0],[a,0,0],[0,0,d]], then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 6|a|^{-2/3}|d|^{-1/3}, stable under arbitrary outside coordinates and cross couplings by conditioning.

new_results.name: BOUNDED_SPECTRAL_JOINT_DENSITY_INSUFFICIENT
new_results.statement: For q=x^2+y^2-z^2 there are unit-volume cone-shell joint densities bounded by one whose pushforward density has supremum at least 1/delta; therefore an arbitrary bounded joint spectral density is insufficient after rotation. This is not a target counterexample because the joint law is dependent.

partner_result_applied.application: After swapping the first two physical coordinates, the partner's bilinear Abel smoothing theorem applies to the same semi-cross block and yields ||p_Q||_infinity <= 4|ad|^{-1/2}. Combined certified envelope is min(4|ad|^{-1/2},6|a|^{-2/3}|d|^{-1/3}).

other_peer_results_applied.use: Diffuse separable-phase comparison; identifies nonseparable residual coupling as a global obstacle.
General invertible principal-triple theorem and fixed-triple diffuse obstruction.

unresolved_implication: BINARY-INDEFINITE-L3: for every independent density<=1 pair and every affine indefinite binary quadratic with discriminant D>0, prove ||p_q||_3 <= C D^{-1/3}. Then address nonzero coupling of the third selected coordinate into both hyperbolic variables and determinant-aggregate selection in diffuse frames.
next_step: Attack BINARY-INDEFINITE-L3 by a hyperbolic-coordinate coarea/rearrangement argument that never rotates the input product law; use the semi-cross bound as the exact boundary case and the partner half-potential theorem as a comparison mechanism.
